answer: A vineyard-agent registry requires an 8-credit burn for every active key each epoch. Admission also requires locating each vine and nearest ridge on a signed atlas within 2 m of hidden survey points. Verifiers consume a burn receipt bound to key and epoch; it cannot license two keys, so 100 aliases burn 800 credits even when idle. Survey answers can be copied, but fees cannot be reused. This makes aliases costly without proving unique owners; wealthy farms and forged survey records remain limits.
